title: Aarti of Shri Ganesh Ji
content:
Jai Ganesh, Jai Ganesh, Jai Ganesh Deva.
Mata Jaki Parvati, Pita Mahadeva.

Ek dant dayavant, char bhuja dhari.
Mathe sindur sohe, muse ki savari.

Andhan ko aankh det, kodhin ko kaya.
Banjhan ko putra det, nirdhan ko maya.

Haar chadhe phool chadhe, aur chadhe meva.
Ladduan ka bhog lage, sant karen seva.

title: Aarti of Lord Shiva
content:
Jai Shiv Omkara, Har Om Shiv Omkara.
Brahma Vishnu Sadashiv, Ardhangi dhara.

Ekanan Chaturanan Panchanan raje.
Hansasan Garudasan Vrishvahan saje.

Do bhuj charu chaturbhuj das bhuj ati sohe.
Teenon roop nirakhta tribhuvan jan mohe.

title: Aarti of Shri Ramchandra Ji
content:
Shri Ramchandra kripalu bhaju man haran bhavbhay daarunam.
Navkanj lochan, kanjmukh, karkanj, padkanjaarunam.

Kandarp aganit amit chhabi, navneelneerad sundaram.
Pat peet manahu tadit ruchi shuchi naumi Janak sutaavaram.

Bhaju deenbandhu dinesh daanavdaityavanshnikandanam.
Raghunand aanandakand Koshalchand Dashrathnandanam.

title: Aarti of Shri Lakshmi Mata
content:
Om Jai Lakshmi Mata, Maiya Jai Lakshmi Mata.
Tumko nisdin sevat, har Vishnu Vidhata.

Uma, Rama, Brahmani, tum jag ki mata.
Surya Chandrama dhyavat, Narad Rishi gata.

Durgarup Niranjan, sukh sampatti data.
Jo koi तुमको dhyata, riddhi siddhi dhan pata.
